title: 디지털 시대의 교육, 정보, 방송의 관계모색

abstracts.value:
디지털에 함의되어 있는 의미와 인간의 삶에 미친 영향을 교육적 시각에서 되짚어 보아야 하는 시점이다. 왜냐하면 교육분야의 향후발전은 디지털에 대해 어떠한 문제의식을 갖느냐, 디지털 미디어가 제공하는 무궁무진한 정보를 교육적 관점, 사회 문화적 시각에서 얼마나 진지하게 수용하느냐에 달려있기 때문이다.
본 고에서는 디지털 시대에서의 ‘교육’과 ‘정보’의 의미를 되짚어 보고 특히, 교육, 정보, 방송이 통합되어 만들어 가는 ‘교육정보방송’의 새로운 관계맺음 방식을 정립한다. 이를 위해 사회·문화적 맥락 속에서의 교육의 위치, 디지털 시대의 학습의 변화 과정, 그리고 디지털 시대의 새로운 학습 능력인 디지털 리터러시의 의미를 살펴본다. 또한 이를 통해 교육, 정보, 방송의 향후 관계 모색에 대한 교육공학의 역할을 재조명한다

It's time to reflect on the true meaning of the digital era and the effectiveness on the human life in the educational view. The development of our educational field largely depends on the attitudes of how deeply we consider over the digital era and how carefully we accept the overabundant information. But most of all, the main reason of considering over the education in the digital era, is that the way of representing the education in the digital culture is different from that in the analogue culture.
The educational ideas and practices - for instance, the educational purpose, contents, instruction, administration - should be changed, including the main elements in the digital culture : the network-relationships, compositions in the procedure, reciprocal actions and the sharing.
This study converges on the meanings of 'education' and 'information', and especially builds up the new relationships of education, information, and broadcasting, naming the 'Educational Information and Broadcasting.' So the educational position in the socio-culture, the process of the digital learning changes and the meanings of digital literacy as the new ways of learning ability are studied over, either.
The digital literacy will reduce the gap of the following various differences: between the present generation and N-generation, the analogue culture and digital culture, and, finally, individual work and cooperative work.
Through this procedure, the roles in the educational technology will be studied over. The ways of applying IT(Information and Technology) in educational technology field is the more vital task than just the appliance of IT, how to ues IT as tools is much more important than how to learn from IT. Via this procedure, the learning environment, the construction of information and the storing-up of knowledge will be made. Therefore, the studying field of educational development should expand over social media to look for the socio-cultural actual problems.
